rootCauseOneLine: printThreadTable in apps/cli/src/commands/thread/list.ts maps rows to [id, projectId, status] with a hardcoded ["ID","Project","Status"] header and never reads thread.title/titleFallback, even though the server payload (and --json) carries them.
proposedFix: Add a Title column to printThreadTable in apps/cli/src/commands/thread/list.ts resolved as title -> titleFallback -> "-", collapsed to one line and truncated (~60 chars with ellipsis); column order ID, Title, Project, Status. Update the two exact-string layout tests in apps/cli/src/__tests__/command-output/thread-list.test.ts. Prototype diff at /tmp/bb-reports/issues/1648/repro/proposed-fix.diff verified live and with the repro test. Optionally (per #1760) resolve projectId to project name in a follow-up.
caveats: Not a regression: identical code at desktop-v0.37.0 and on origin/main after base; no upstream fix. Side observation: renderBorderlessTable (cli-table3, mid "-") draws a separator between every row in multi-row tables. When run from inside a bb agent thread, BB_CLI causes re-exec of the daemon binary; I unset it to test the worktree build. Worktree left with the prototype fix and repro test uncommitted (apps/cli/src/commands/thread/list.ts modified, thread-list-title-repro.test.ts added).
